test_case.test_name: AMD RCD/DRAM parity correctable error per slot
test_case.purpose: For every approved RCD/DIMM target, inject one correctable parity event and prove attributable correction with continued service and no warm reset or UCE escalation.
required_package: Vendor-correct listvalidumc syntax and AMD package contract
OS-specific event timeout plus service/no-reset monitoring
Abort, unexpected-BERT capture, recovery and BIOS/HDT restoration
test_case.test_command: Using only vendor-approved CLI syntax, map one RCD/DIMM target, capture parity/MCA baseline, and have the FAE execute one signed errortype0 parity stimulus. Correlate the exact corrected source/location, verify service continuity and no reset, retain BERT/OOB evidence if unexpected escalation occurs, then disable injection and restore settings.
test_case.expected_result: Each required target reports the specified correctable parity event within timeout, remains operational without warm reset/UCE, and returns RCD parity, MCA, HDT and tool state to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires per-slot mapping, tool PASS, corrected parity evidence and stable service/no reset. UCE, warm reset or BERT fatal evidence is diagnostic FAIL for this CE case and belongs to row53 coverage, never an alternate PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated ECC/RCD platform with OOB console.
Use only vendor-correct syntax and one mapped target.
Abort on wrong slot, UCE, sync flood, reset, boot failure or service loss.
No retry; preserve BERT/UEFI/BMC before recovery if escalation occurs.
expected_evidence: Full CE parity command and exact source/location record
Service/no-reset evidence and any unexpected BERT capture
test_case.recovery: If escalation/reset occurs, stop CE coverage, capture BERT/UEFI/BMC and OOB timeline, apply approved recovery, disable injection and restore RCD parity/MCA/HDT state before any separately authorized investigation.
